sentences.text:
Author: Manju Rani Chauhan
Bench: Manju Rani Chauhan
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Court No. - 45
Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 43615 of 2022
Applicant :- Shantam Babbar And 6 Others

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another Counsel for Applicant :- Santosh Kumar Mishra,Pradeep Kumar Sharma Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Mrs. Manju Rani Chauhan,J.
Supplementary affidavit filed by learned counsel for the applicants today in the Court, is taken on record.
Office is directed to register the same.

Heard Mr. Santosh Kumar Mishra, learned counsel for the applicants, and Mr. Pankaj Srivastava,
learned A.G.A. for the State.

The present 482 Cr.P.C. application has been filed to quash the charge sheet dated 21.05.2021 as well as the entire proceedings of Case No.1835 of 2022 (State vs. Shantam Babbar & others), arising out of Case Crime No.1190 of 2020, under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506, 307, 328, 354A, 354B IPC and section Sectin 3/4 of D.P. Act, Police Station-Kankar Khera, District-Meerut, pending in the Court of Chief Judicial Magistrate, Meerut.

entities.text: Case No.1835 of 2022 (State vs. Shantam Babbar & others)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

entities.text: Court of Chief Judicial Magistrate, Meerut
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Learned counsel for the applicants submits that there was matrimonial discord between the parties,
due to which a case under Section 13 B of Hindu Marriage Act was filed, which has been decreed vide order dated 04.01.2023, certified copy of which order has been annexed as Annexure no.S.A-1 to the supplementary affidavit filed today.
After the aforesaid order, the parties have amicably settled their dispute and have entered into compromise.

In this regard, the compromise application Shantam Babbar And 6 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 21 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/77610069/
1 has been filed before the court concerned, which has been rejected vide order dated 06.01.2023 on the ground that it is non-cognizable offences, copy of which order has been annexed as Annexure no.S.A.-3 to the supplementary affidavit.

entities.text: Shantam Babbar And 6 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: However, the aforesaid order dated 06.01.2023 is not challenged before this Court.
Let an amendment application be filed for the same by the next date fixed.
On the request of learned counsel for the applicant, put up this case on 24.02.2023 as fresh.

Order Date :- 21.2.2023 Jitendra/-
